$comment: AGT2 sbx: workspace Node 24.22.2, CPython3.14.9 with NumPy2.5.4 and Pillow13.0.0, and HyperFrames CLI0.8.209-1, with a narrow Chrome157 drawElement/paint-timeout port and complete corresponding source. Built from workspace/pins.mjs and hyperframes-cli.lock.json using workspace/pack.mjs. Hosted on2026-11-11; Node preserves the Node.js Foundation signature and notarisation, Python and the CLI are Developer ID-signed by Matterward Labs and Apple-notarised. Artifacts and complete licence notices are pinned by SHA-256. On-demand installation needs no developer override. OpenCV remains held (pins.mjs HELD_WHEELS).
